name: Crispy Smoked Salmon Sandwich with Lemon Tartar Sauce & Side Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ bunches radish
3 tomatoes
3 avocados
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl (reserve lemons for later use).
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Mince capers; add to the bowl along with mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the tartar sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp capers
½ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
Dijon mustard
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add smoked salmon slices to the skillet in a single layer; cook, flipping once, until crispy, about 4 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
3 (113 g) pkgs smoked salmon

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice reserved lemons into a large bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallots; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl.
Small dice half the tomatoes and add to the bowl. Thinly slice remaining tomatoes and place on a plate for serving.
Halve avocados and remove pits; scoop out the flesh. Medium dice half the avocados and add to the bowl. Thinly slice remaining avocados and add to the plate with the sliced tomato; set aside.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 2 leaves per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.

Place the bottom half of a roll on each plate. Layer with tartar sauce, lettuce, tomato, crispy smoked salmon, and avocado; close with the top half of each roll. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
